story.title: Humanitarian AI agents deployed by IRC provide critical assistance to refugees as crises outpace capacity
story.summary: The International Rescue Committee has deployed purpose-built AI agents to provide information and assistance to refugees and displaced populations, as humanitarian organisations face caseloads that vastly exceed human staff capacity. The AI system is designed with a safety-first architecture, aiming to avoid the harms that general-purpose AI tools can cause in high-stakes, vulnerable-population contexts. The deployment represents one of the most significant real-world tests of AI in the humanitarian sector to date.
